result.topic_en: For the prime 149 = (7+10i)(7-10i), with i ≡ 44, the page tabulates powers of the primitive root 2 mod 149, indices of small primes and of small Gaussian integers, and their indices mod 4 (biquadratic characters).

methods.what: Factorization of the prime 149 as a norm of the Gaussian integer 7+10i, with a square root of -1 modulo 149
Table of successive powers of the primitive root 2 modulo 149, written as absolute least residues
Index table: indices of -1 and small primes with respect to base 2 modulo 149
Index relations for consecutive residues (cyclotomic-type relations)
Table of small Gaussian integers reduced modulo 7+10i, with their indices and the indices mod 4 (biquadratic character)
Reduction of a+bi modulo 7-10i via bounds obtained by multiplying by the conjugate
